brief.headline: The glasses are wired: web-app bridge on Node 001 runs the real Spotter and renders a HUD to the Ray-Ban Display. Data plane written. Web-app path chosen and built.

items.text: Built the glasses web-app bridge — the chosen path onto the Ray-Ban Display. A relay on Node 001 serves a glanceable HUD to the glasses' web view and answers /assess by shelling to the REAL `sentinel spot` (never reimplements Spotter) and /brief from state.json. Fails closed on its token, degrades to an honest card with no binary, blocks path traversal. 20 tests. Verified end-to-end: page → /assess → sentinel spot → HUD card rendered (Hikvision, critical, 4 risk pips, spoken action), zero console errors.

Wrote the Node 001 Phase-1 data plane: one Compose file (Ollama+GPU, Open WebUI, Postgres, Qdrant, Redis, Caddy), a Caddyfile serving the HUD over `tls internal` (the secure context the web view needs for camera/mic) and proxying the bridge, a Makefile (make bootstrap), and .env.example. Only Caddy publishes ports — the brain isn't exposed to the LAN. `docker compose config` validates. `make bootstrap` after Docker's installed and it's live.

Shipped jarvisd: an always-on 'Hey Jarvis' daemon (openWakeWord pretrained model, local faster-whisper STT, ElevenLabs-or-system voice). Starts at login, opens the HUD, has the brief ready on boot, and degrades to typed commands with no mic. 54 tests.

Added a daily-improvement ledger the daemon enforces: every entry must name an improvement AND the pain it removes, so a day cannot be closed by recording activity. 'What did you do yesterday' reads it back.

Voice power-on for Node 001: Wake-on-LAN sender + authenticated bridge endpoint, plus verified Windows/BIOS setup (Fast Startup is the silent killer) and an honest smart-plug fallback. Alexa/Shortcuts/Home Assistant can now boot the PC.

Recorded CentLabs Workspace v1 as an architecture decision record (device topology, all 10 phases with WHY/tradeoffs, container-runtime analysis, build order) plus the iPhone-14 headless-node design and recovery runbook — so the projects are never explained twice.

AEGIS view models: enter any crew seat and you are holding something — rifle with iron sights, scoped M107, pintle .50 with a feeding belt, Apache canopy with glareshield MFDs, binoculars at the gun line. They sway with movement, kick with the unit's real recoil and muzzle-flash when it actually fires. Kept solid in both render modes deliberately: the weapon is the operator's hands, not part of the projection.

AEGIS theater-wide war: 114 units on three simultaneous axes — armour at the city, mech infantry in the hills, a recon screen on the flank — with fires in depth at the map edges whose 21/32 km reach covers every sector. Battle infantry now fight on foot on the articulated rig: walk on the advance, braced aim in contact, a fall about the feet when killed, rifle riding the hand throughout.

Playtested three full walk-in sessions end to end. Caught and fixed: battle stop() crashing on the new infantry rig fleets, view models eaten by the camera near plane, the holo wash rendering the weapon invisible, and table-scale civilians towering like giants over the metric battle from any eye-level camera (the crowd drops to metric scale whenever the camera is on the deck).

Found why the city disappeared on the owner's iPhone in photoreal mode. buildCity thinned its field to the 430-building budget and then pushed up to six signature towers in AFTER the cut, so it returned 434-436 — 12 of the first 15 sites over. index.html then asked GL to draw more instances than the buffer held. That is INVALID_OPERATION per the WebGL spec: Chrome tolerates it via robust buffer access and reports no error, which is why every desktop and headless test passed, while WebKit drops the whole draw call. Real mode made it total because the wireframe cages that survived in holo are faded to zero there. Fixed at the generator and guarded at the consumer; every skyline is unchanged.

tasks.title: jarvisd — install on Node 001 + MacBook (autostart)
tasks.note: install/ scripts per OS; enable-wol.ps1 + BIOS for voice power-on. Needs the real machines.

tasks.title: CentLabs Phase 1 — Node 001 base (WSL2 + Docker + NVIDIA + Compose data plane)

tasks.note: Web-app path is built (centlabs/bridge/). Native path is the upgrade: feeds real camera frames to Spotter over the same /assess API. Needs the four Meta IDs + Apple Developer account (CONNECT-CHECKLIST §5).

tasks.title: Sentinel: audit-chain tamper tests
